comparison.objective: Lock a bicycle wheel to a stand using a two-part U-lock.
comparison.physical_skill: Thread a rigid shackle through spokes and around a post, then align a crossbar onto both legs simultaneously.
comparison.success_condition: Shackle encloses both wheel and stand; both ends inserted ≥16 mm within 4 mm alignment, caught, still, and released.
comparison.reason: Tests spatial threading and simultaneous dual-leg insertion, not fine-tool torque, moving-socket reacquisition, or damping commissioning.
